address: 58, Section 3, Yanping North Road, Datong District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Founded in the 1960s, Shih Chia is synonymous with savoury Miaoli Hakkanese-style glutinous rice balls with a juicy pork and vegetable filling. The second-generation owner strictly follows his mother's recipe and uses only year-old round-grain sticky rice to make the toothsome elastic dough. There are also snacks from Fujian and other Chinese provinces. The scallion oil chicken drumsticks feature springy, thinly sliced meat, elevated by a delicate scallion oil aroma. Check its social media for opening hours.
